token_estimate: ceil(bytes/4); same proxy for every arm

baseline.label: no-memory baseline
baseline.notes: Agent reads files on demand (grep). No store, so S6/S9/S10 have nothing to tamper, poison or leak; graded n/a there.

native.label: native CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / auto memory (simulated per docs)
native.notes: Loader simulated from the published docs, not by running the claude binary. Auto memory content is written by Claude itself; the bench writes the line Claude would write (remember()).

kronicle-lite.label: kronicle-lite
setupSteps: claude mcp add kronicle-lite -- kronicle-lite serve
SessionStart+FileChanged hook: kronicle-lite put --from-instructions --stdin-hook (or run `kronicle-lite watch docs/`)
kronicle-lite.notes: MCP stdio. Data dir = default ~/.kronicle-lite under an isolated HOME.

server-memory.label: @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
setupSteps: add the README system prompt (retrieve graph at chat start; store facts as observations)
server-memory.notes: Default MEMORY_FILE_PATH is one memory.jsonl beside the package: every project shares it unless configured.

cc-anchor.label: cc-anchor (card only)
setupSteps: /cc-anchor:anchor set goal "…" + add-invariant "…" as decisions are made
cc-anchor.notes: Card content is written by the agent/user with the anchor command; hooks only persist and re-inject it.

sea-lite.label: sea-lite
setupSteps: claude mcp add sea-lite -- sea-lite serve

sea-lite+cc-anchor.label: sea-lite + cc-anchor hooks
